acceptanceCriteria: root cause identified: which path let a read-only Codex session write the task journal
a read-only review session cannot mutate the task store, or the mutation path requires an explicit operator flag
a regression check or documented qualification records the result
body: During the #801 review, `codex exec -s read-only` still attached evidence to V1-1231 and created V1-1232 in .taskman, even though the sandbox was read-only. The Corvint plugin or skill reachable from Codex apparently writes the task journal outside the workspace sandbox (journal lives in .git/taskman of the primary checkout). Reviewer prompts now say 'do not create tickets or attach evidence' as a workaround.
